decisions: Use broad anonymous visual settings, not nationwide change dates or village reconstructions.
Keep mixed roofs rather than replacing all cottages at 1970.
Southern roof/mechanization references apply only to scenery south of latitude37.7; this cutoff is a display scope, not a border.
Do not turn early-settlement research into exact hut reconstruction; retain a simple shelter silhouette.
Omitting modern decorative tigers is a display choice, not a peninsula extinction claim.
Do not implement the researcher suggestion to extrapolate1970housing back to300BCE as historical evidence.
Building proportions, household counts, clothing and machinery shapes remain symbolic; forests/field boundaries are not historical land-use reconstruction.
